nc92cf07d96.headline: Azerbaijan discusses expansion of innovative payment services with SWIFT
nc92cf07d96.summary: The Central Bank of Azerbaijan is discussing expansion of innovative payment services with SWIFT. The talks are aimed at supporting payment system functioning and banking stability.
nc92cf07d96.why: SWIFT is the global messaging network that banks use for cross-border payments. Changes to payment infrastructure affect how banks and businesses transfer money internationally.

nc668237455.headline: Three possible scenarios for inflation in Serbia
nc668237455.summary: The National Bank of Serbia's May Inflation Report sets out basic, favourable and unfavourable scenarios for GDP and inflation. The scenarios reflect global inflation trends, financial conditions and China's economic recovery.
nc668237455.why: Central bank inflation scenarios guide interest rate expectations, which affect Serbian bond yields and the dinar.
